post.description:
Creates a new custom field definition for the caller's organization and a record type.

**Behavior**
- Saved with status `DRAFT` by default — invisible on every form until moved to `ACTIVE`
  via `PUT /portal/custom-fields/{id}/status`. A different starting `status` may be
  supplied instead (see `status` below), but it must be one of the four recognized
  values — `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE`, `DEPRECATED`, `ARCHIVED` (also listed at
  `GET /portal/custom-fields/schema`). Starting anywhere other than `DRAFT` immediately
  turns on the breaking-change protection that `PUT`/`PATCH` normally only enforce once
  a field leaves draft.
- The organization is always the caller's own — resolved from the Bearer token or
  `X-API-KEY`, never supplied by the client.
- `fieldKey` must be unique within the organization + `entityType` + `fieldNamespace`.
- `widgetType` and `cardinality` are both optional — when either is blank, a sensible
  default is resolved from `dataType` (and from the other of the pair, if given). When
  both are omitted, the simplest widget for `dataType` is chosen with `"SINGLE"`
  cardinality (`"LIST"` only for the default when `cardinality` was requested as `"LIST"`
  on a `SELECT` field).
- `dataType`, `widgetType`, and `cardinality` are each validated independently against
  their own known set of values (see tables below for the recognized `widgetType`s per
  `dataType`, offered as guidance) — supplying any recognized value for each is accepted,
  there is no cross-field pairing requirement between them.
- `options` is required (non-empty) when `dataType` is `SELECT`; each option's
  `optionValue` is auto-generated from `optionLabel` if not supplied.
- The organization's field count for this `entityType` must be under 1000.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entityType` | Yes | string | `GUEST`, `CONTACT`, `EVENT`, `ORGANIZATION`, `TECHAEON`. |
| `scopeEntityType` | No (default `"ORGANIZATION"`) | string | `"ORGANIZATION"` — applies across every event. `"EVENT"` — applies to one event only; requires `scopeId`. |
| `scopeId` | Required when `scopeEntityType` is `"EVENT"`, else omit | uuid | Must be an event belonging to the caller's organization. |
| `fieldNamespace` | No (default `"org"`) | string | Lowercase, starts with a letter, max 50 chars. `system` and `app:*` are reserved. |
| `fieldKey` | Yes | string | Machine key, e.g. `dietary_notes`. Lowercase, starts with a letter, max 60 chars. |
| `label` | Yes | string | Display name shown on forms. Max 120 chars. |
| `helperText` | No | string | Help text shown beneath the field. |
| `dataType` | Yes | string | `TEXT`, `LONGTEXT`, `NUMBER`, `DECIMAL`, `BOOLEAN`, `DATE`, `DATETIME`, `SELECT`, `EMAIL`, `PHONE`, `URL`. Only `TEXT`, `LONGTEXT`, `NUMBER`, `BOOLEAN`, `DATE`, `SELECT` are usable today. |
| `widgetType` | No | string | Any recognized widget type (see table below for the suggested pairing per `dataType`). Auto-derived from `dataType`/`cardinality` when omitted or blank. |
| `cardinality` | No | string | `"SINGLE"` or `"LIST"`. Auto-derived from `dataType`/`widgetType` when omitted or blank. |
| `isMandatory` | No (default `false`) | bool | Whether a value is required to submit the form. |
| `isPii` | No (default `false`) | bool | Flags this field as personal data. |
| `status` | No (default `"DRAFT"`) | string | One of `"DRAFT"`, `"ACTIVE"`, `"DEPRECATED"`, `"ARCHIVED"`. |
| `validationRules` | No | object | Extra rules; legal keys depend on `dataType` (e.g. `{"maxLength":200}` for `TEXT`). |
| `uiHints` | No | object | `placeholder`, `helpLink`, `showInGrid`, `gridWidth`, `rows`, `currencyCode`. |
| `groupKey` | No | string | Free-text section heading for grouping fields on a form. |
| `orderIndex` | No (default `0`) | int | Sort position; lower shows first. |
| `options` | Required for `SELECT`, else omit | array | Each item: `optionLabel` (required), `optionValue` (optional, auto-generated), `orderIndex`. |

**`dataType` → suggested `widgetType`** (guidance only — not enforced)

| dataType | Suggested widgetType |
|---|---|
| `TEXT` | `TEXT_INPUT` |
| `LONGTEXT` | `TEXTAREA` |
| `NUMBER` | `NUMBER_INPUT`, `STEPPER` |
| `DECIMAL` | `NUMBER_INPUT`, `CURRENCY_INPUT` |
| `BOOLEAN` | `CHECKBOX`, `TOGGLE`, `RADIO_YES_NO` |
| `DATE` | `DATE_PICKER` |
| `DATETIME` | `DATETIME_PICKER` |
| `SELECT` | `RADIO_GROUP`, `DROPDOWN`, `CHECKBOX_GROUP`, `MULTI_SELECT` |
| `EMAIL` | `EMAIL_INPUT` |
| `PHONE` | `PHONE_INPUT` |
| `URL` | `URL_INPUT` |

**Response `200`** — the created definition (`CustomFieldDefinitionDto`): `id`,
`organizationId`, `entityType`, `scopeEntityType`, `scopeId`, `fieldNamespace`,
`fieldKey`, `label`, `helperText`, `dataType`, `widgetType`, `cardinality`,
`isMandatory`, `isPii`, `status`, `validationRules` and
`uiHints` (serialized as JSON strings), `groupKey`, `orderIndex`, and `options`
(with resolved `optionValue`s).

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_UNKNOWN_ENTITY_TYPE` | `entityType` isn't a recognized record type. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Organization already has the max fields for this `entityType`. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_DUPLICATE_KEY` | `fieldKey` already used for this org + entityType + namespace. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_DATATYPE` | `dataType` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_WIDGET_TYPE` | `widgetType` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_CARDINALITY` | `cardinality` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_STATUS` | `status` is supplied and isn't one of the recognized values. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_UNKNOWN_RULE_KEY` | `validationRules`/`uiHints` has a key not legal for `dataType`. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_RESERVED_NAMESPACE` | `fieldNamespace` is `system` or starts with `app:`. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_NO_ORGANIZATION_CONTEXT` | Caller has no resolvable organization context. |

get.summary: List an organization's custom fields for a record type.
get.description:
Returns every definition for the caller's organization and the given record type — the
field dictionary screen's data source.

**Behavior**
- Returns fields in every status (`DRAFT`, `ACTIVE`, `DEPRECATED`, `ARCHIVED`) by
  default — pass `status` to narrow the result to one exact status server-side instead of
  filtering client-side.
- Ordered by `orderIndex` ascending.
- The organization is always the caller's own — resolved from the Bearer token or
  `X-API-KEY`, never supplied by the client.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request**

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entityType` | Yes (query) | string | Record type, e.g. `GUEST`. |
| `status` | No (query) | string | Exact status to filter to, e.g. `ACTIVE`. Omit to return every status. |

**Response `200`** — array of `CustomFieldDefinitionDto`, same shape as the create
endpoint's response, each including its `options`.

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_NO_ORGANIZATION_CONTEXT` | Caller has no resolvable organization context. |

put.summary: Reorder a record type's custom fields.
put.description:
Bulk-updates the sort position (`orderIndex`) of the given definitions in one call —
the field dictionary's drag-to-reorder list uses this.

**Behavior**
- Fields not listed in `ordering` keep their current position.
- Every `id` must belong to the caller's organization + `entityType`; any that don't are
  silently skipped rather than erroring.
- The organization is always the caller's own — resolved from the Bearer token or
  `X-API-KEY`, never supplied by the client.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entityType` | Yes (route) | string | Record type the fields belong to, e.g. `GUEST`. |
| `ordering` | Yes | array | One entry per field being repositioned: `{ "id": guid, "orderIndex": int }`. |

**Response `200`** — `true` on success.

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_NO_ORGANIZATION_CONTEXT` | Caller has no resolvable organization context. |

delete.description:
Soft-deletes (`isactive = false`) a custom field definition.

**Behavior**
- Only permitted while the field is still `DRAFT` — GlobalDb has no way to confirm a
  field past `DRAFT` is unused (values live in the database that owns the record, e.g.
  EventDb for guests), so this endpoint refuses rather than risk deleting a field with
  existing answers.
- For an `ACTIVE` or `DEPRECATED` field, move it to `DEPRECATED`/`ARCHIVED` instead via
  `PUT /portal/custom-fields/{id}/status` — its existing answers stay visible and
  exportable.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request**

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | Yes (route) | guid | The definition to delete. |

**Response:** `204 No Content` on success, with no response body. On failure, returns an
error response describing what went wrong.

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_BREAKING_CHANGE` | Field is not `DRAFT`. |
| `ORGANIZATION_ID_MISMATCH` | Caller's organization doesn't own this field. |

**`404`** if `id` doesn't exist.

get.summary: Fetch a single custom field definition, with its options.
get.description:
Fetches one custom field definition by id, in any status.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request**

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | Yes (route) | guid | The definition to fetch. |

**Response `200`** — `CustomFieldDefinitionDto`: `id`, `organizationId`, `entityType`,
`scopeEntityType`, `scopeId`, `fieldNamespace`, `fieldKey`, `label`, `helperText`,
`dataType`, `widgetType`, `cardinality`, `isMandatory`, `isPii`, `status`,
`validationRules`/`uiHints` (serialized JSON strings), `groupKey`, `orderIndex`, and
`options` (array of `{ id, optionValue, optionLabel, orderIndex }`).

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `ORGANIZATION_ID_MISMATCH` | Caller's organization doesn't own this field. |

**`404`** if `id` doesn't exist.

patch.summary: Partially update a custom field — only the fields you send are touched.
patch.description:
Updates only the fields present in the request body. This is a true partial update
(JSON Merge Patch semantics), unlike `PUT /portal/custom-fields/{id}` which replaces
the whole mutable shape and requires every field on every call.

**Every field is a plain value in the JSON — never a `{ "isSet": ..., "value": ... }`
wrapper.** That shape only exists internally to tell "omitted" apart from "sent as
null"; sending it literally as JSON will fail to deserialize. For example, to rename a
field and touch nothing else:
```json
{
  "label": "Dietary Notes (internal)"
}
```
`fieldKey`, `dataType`, `validationRules`, etc. are simply absent from the body above —
they are left exactly as they are today.

- **Omit a field** to leave it completely unchanged.
- **Send a field with a value** to set/replace it.
- **Send a field as explicit `null`** to clear it, where the domain allows it (e.g.
  `helperText`, `groupKey`, `validationRules`, `uiHints`). Fields that can never be
  empty on a definition (`fieldKey`, `label`, `dataType`, `isMandatory`, `isPii`,
  `orderIndex`) reject an explicit `null` with a validation error instead of silently
  ignoring it.
- `widgetType` and `cardinality` are the two exceptions to that rule: they can never
  truly be empty either (the entity always has a concrete widget), but an explicit
  `null` there means "re-derive the default from `dataType`" rather than being
  rejected — the same blank-means-auto-resolve convention `POST`/`PUT` use.
- `options` is the other exception — it's a plain nested array, not the omit/value/null
  tri-state, because there's no separate "clear" behavior to distinguish from "replace
  with nothing". Omit the key to leave options untouched, send `[]` to remove all, or
  send a non-empty array to fully replace the set.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Behavior**
- Once the field is no longer `DRAFT`, changing `dataType`, `cardinality`, turning
  `isMandatory` on, or removing an `options` entry that may already have answers is
  refused with `CUSTOM_FIELD_BREAKING_CHANGE` — same rule `PUT` enforces. While still
  `DRAFT`, anything goes.
- `fieldKey` can be renamed freely (must stay unique for this org + entityType + namespace).
- `dataType`, `widgetType`, and `cardinality` are each validated independently against
  their own known set of values — there is no cross-field pairing requirement.

**Request body**

| Field | Clearable | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `fieldKey` | No | Machine key. Renaming is a safe change. |
| `label` | No | Display name. Max 120 chars. |
| `helperText` | Yes | Help text shown beneath the field. |
| `dataType` | No | Same closed list as create. Changing it post-`DRAFT` is refused. |
| `widgetType` | Re-derives default | Any recognized widget type. |
| `cardinality` | Re-derives default | `"SINGLE"` or `"LIST"`. Changing it post-`DRAFT` is refused. |
| `isMandatory` | No | Turning on post-`DRAFT` is refused; turning off is always safe. |
| `isPii` | No | Flags this field as personal data. |
| `validationRules` | Yes | Full replacement of the whole object when sent; legal keys depend on `dataType`. |
| `uiHints` | Yes | Full replacement of the whole object when sent. |
| `groupKey` | Yes | Free-text section heading. |
| `orderIndex` | No | Sort position. |
| `options` | N/A (see above) | `null`/omit = untouched, `[]` = remove all, non-empty = full replace. |

**Response `200`** — the patched definition (`CustomFieldDefinitionDto`), same shape as
the create/update endpoints' response.

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_DUPLICATE_KEY` | New `fieldKey` collides with another field in this org + entityType + namespace. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_DATATYPE` | `dataType` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_WIDGET_TYPE` | `widgetType` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_CARDINALITY` | `cardinality` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_UNKNOWN_RULE_KEY` | `validationRules`/`uiHints` has a key not legal for `dataType`. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_BREAKING_CHANGE` | Data type/cardinality/mandatory/option removal attempted on a non-DRAFT field. |
| `ORGANIZATION_ID_MISMATCH` | Caller's organization doesn't own this field. |

**`404`** if `id` doesn't exist.

put.description:
Updates label, help text, rules, options and ordering for an existing custom field.
This is a full update of the mutable shape — send every field, not just the ones
changing.

**Behavior**
- `fieldKey` can be renamed freely (must stay unique for this org + entityType + namespace).
- Once the field is no longer `DRAFT`, changing `dataType`, `cardinality`, turning
  `isMandatory` on, or removing an `options` entry that may already have answers is
  refused with `CUSTOM_FIELD_BREAKING_CHANGE` — deprecate the field (via
  `PUT /portal/custom-fields/{id}/status`) and create a replacement instead. While
  still `DRAFT`, anything goes.
- `options`: omit the property (or send `null`) to leave options untouched; send an
  empty array to remove all options; send a non-empty array to fully replace the set —
  include an existing option's `id` to keep it, leave it out to delete it.
- `widgetType` and `cardinality` are both optional — when either is blank, a sensible
  default is resolved from `dataType` (and from the other of the pair, if given), the
  same way as create. Each of `dataType`/`widgetType`/`cardinality` is validated
  independently against its own known set of values — there is no cross-field pairing
  requirement between them.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | Yes (route) | guid | The definition being updated. |
| `fieldKey` | Yes | string | Machine key. Renaming is a safe change. |
| `label` | Yes | string | Display name. Max 120 chars. |
| `helperText` | No | string | Help text shown beneath the field. |
| `dataType` | Yes | string | Same closed list as create. Changing it post-`DRAFT` is refused. |
| `widgetType` | No | string | Any recognized widget type. Auto-derived when omitted or blank. Changing only the widget never invalidates data. |
| `cardinality` | No | string | Auto-derived when omitted or blank. Changing it post-`DRAFT` is refused. |
| `isMandatory` | No (default `false`) | bool | Turning on post-`DRAFT` is refused; turning off is always safe. |
| `isPii` | No (default `false`) | bool | Flags this field as personal data. |
| `validationRules` | No | object | Full replacement; omit/null clears all rules. |
| `uiHints` | No | object | Full replacement; omit/null clears all hints. |
| `groupKey` | No | string | Free-text section heading. |
| `orderIndex` | No (default `0`) | int | Sort position. |
| `options` | No | array or `null` | `null`/omit = untouched, `[]` = remove all, non-empty = full replace. |

**Response `200`** — the updated definition (`CustomFieldDefinitionDto`), same shape as
the create endpoint's response.

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_DUPLICATE_KEY` | New `fieldKey` collides with another field in this org + entityType + namespace. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_DATATYPE` | `dataType` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_WIDGET_TYPE` | `widgetType` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_CARDINALITY` | `cardinality` isn't a recognized value. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_UNKNOWN_RULE_KEY` | `validationRules`/`uiHints` has a key not legal for `dataType`. |
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_BREAKING_CHANGE` | Data type/cardinality/mandatory/option removal attempted on a non-DRAFT field. |
| `ORGANIZATION_ID_MISMATCH` | Caller's organization doesn't own this field. |

**`404`** if `id` doesn't exist.

Sets a definition's status to one of the recognized values — the field dictionary's
status control uses this.

**Behavior**
- `status` must be one of `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE`, `DEPRECATED`, `ARCHIVED` (also listed at
  `GET /portal/custom-fields/schema`). There is no required transition order — any of
  the four may move to any other.
- `DRAFT` remains the one status the platform treats specially: while a definition holds
  it, shape changes via `PUT`/`PATCH /portal/custom-fields/{id}` are unrestricted. Moving
  it to any other status turns on the breaking-change protection on those endpoints.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | Yes (route) | guid | The definition being updated. |
| `status` | Yes | string | One of `"DRAFT"`, `"ACTIVE"`, `"DEPRECATED"`, `"ARCHIVED"`. |

**Response `200`** — the definition with its new `status` (`CustomFieldDefinitionDto`).

**Error codes (`400`)**

| Code | Cause |
|---|---|
| `CUSTOM_FIELD_INVALID_STATUS` | `status` is empty or isn't one of the recognized values. |
| `ORGANIZATION_ID_MISMATCH` | Caller's organization doesn't own this field. |

**`404`** if `id` doesn't exist.

get.summary: Fetch the custom field data type / widget / rule-key matrix.
get.description:
Static metadata describing what values are legal when defining a custom field — call
this before Create/Update/Patch to build a valid request rather than hardcoding the matrix.

**Behavior:** no database access; purely reflects the platform's code constants. Same
result for every caller.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, or `X-API-KEY` for organization-to-organization callers.

**Request:** none.

**Response `200`** — `CustomFieldSchemaDto`:

| Field | Type | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `dataTypes` | string[] | All 11 planned data types. |
| `phase1SupportedDataTypes` | string[] | The subset currently usable: `TEXT`, `LONGTEXT`, `NUMBER`, `BOOLEAN`, `DATE`, `SELECT`. |
| `widgetTypes` | string[] | All 17 widget types. |
| `cardinalities` | string[] | `["SINGLE", "LIST"]`. |
| `statuses` | string[] | The full set of recognized statuses: `["DRAFT", "ACTIVE", "DEPRECATED", "ARCHIVED"]` — see `PUT /portal/custom-fields/{id}/status`. |
| `uiHintKeys` | string[] | Recognized `uiHints` keys: `placeholder`, `helpLink`, `showInGrid`, `gridWidth`, `rows`, `currencyCode`. |
| `legalWidgetsByDataType` | object | Map of `dataType` → array of legal `widgetType` values. |
| `legalValidationRuleKeysByDataType` | object | Map of `dataType` → array of legal `validationRules` keys. |
